title: You Need to Leave
blurb: Customer-service composure applied to what is unmistakably an eviction. Unlike a shouted GET OUT, this keeps a level professional tone the whole way through, and somehow that makes it worse. There is no heat to argue with, only a decision reached before you were told about it. It suits guests who have outstayed the evening, jokes that went one step past the line, and intrusive thoughts being shown the door. Security has been notified, the exit is that way, and you need to leave.
